self_assessment.qualification: Implementation self-assessment; an independent agent must review the sealed evidence before promotion.

matched_m235_comparison.verdict: M236 is not the area winner. If the M235 0.001728 captured coefficient-only bound is admitted by later event/accuracy work, select M235 64-entry/one-Newton. Retain M236 only as a lower-error Pareto option; energy is unresolved and eight products likely require explicit SAIF comparison.
matched_m235_comparison.cycle_qualification: M236 has measured unstalled II13. M235's published maximum observed interval of 15 includes its directed output stall and is not a matched intrinsic-II number; no relative throughput claim is made.

allowed_claims: M236 processes the complete 220800-pair M233 checkpoint population and includes all six previously omitted high-index extrema.
Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS produces zero integer mismatches with first-result latency 11 and maximum unstalled accept interval 13 cycles.
At 3 ns TSMC28 HPC+ logic-only DC, M236 has 3376.926005 um2 cell area and meets setup/hold under the stated ideal-clock ZeroWireload assumptions.
M236 lowers the captured coefficient-only maximum interval bound by 9.009% and LUT payload by 75% versus M235, but increases matched logic-only DC area by 7.260%.
M235 64+1 should remain preferred if its later event/accuracy budget is sufficient; M236 16+2 is a lower-error alternative, not an area optimization.
